## Objective

Serve independent project context and bounded read-only owner adapters.

## Scope

- Make the shared reader start independently of optional knowledge
- Read canonical work and its explicit references
- Reuse knowledge and permitted memory readers
- Unify permitted source viewing and lexical search
- Read capability health and installed help

## Entry conditions

- Phase 1 contracts and preservation boundaries are accepted.

## Exit criteria

- Core startup is independent of optional knowledge; Work, knowledge, memory, source/search and capability adapters meet their bounded contracts.

## Risks

- Untrusted helper discovery, owner scope leakage and optional failure coupling are the principal risks.

## TASK-003 - Make the shared reader start independently of optional knowledge

Extend the existing Explorer package with an explicit Project-app entry and mode. Reuse its reviewed asset/session transport, but establish project context before loading a lazy optional ontology reader; pin and validate all new executing modules and versioned app response contracts.

### Risks

- Both Service startup and frontend context currently depend on ontology; changing only routing is insufficient.
- Refactor shared mechanics once; do not fork a permanent service, frontend or knowledge implementation.

### Acceptance criteria

- Project-app mode can serve Home and available modules with missing or invalid optional ontology configuration, and reports the affected adapter clearly.
- The standalone ontology.py explore path retains its knowledge-first semantics and supported legacy routes.
- New operations retain loopback, Host/Origin, session/request-token, safe error, bounded input, no-follow source and package-change checks. Reading writes only documented app transient state.

### Planned verification

- Review the new startup and dispatch paths against the existing Service and worker startup, closure verification and read-only allowlist; record any changed-control gap for TASK-017.

## TASK-004 - Read canonical work and its explicit references

Add bounded read adapters for supported Task status/list/show and read-only continue packets where related references are needed, TRD list/show and implementation-plan list/show. Validate exact installed owner compatibility before invoking trusted read routes with fixed arguments and budgets; return canonical records and explicit relationship/source references.

| Field | Value |

| Status | `planned` |
| State reason | None |
| Skip authority | None |
| Requirements | REQ-006, REQ-013, REQ-014, REQ-015, REQ-016, REQ-020, REQ-021 |
| Design basis | None |
| Target artifacts | SKILLS-depo/ontology/scripts/project_app_work.py, SKILLS-depo/ontology/assets/project-app/owner-compatibility.json, SKILLS-depo/ontology/references/project-app-contract.md |
| Dependencies | TASK-003 |
| Parallel group | None |
| Completed at | None |

### Risks

- Do not dynamically import or execute unknown project helper code because its filename matches.
- Preserve owner limits and report partial catalog coverage instead of implying no work.

### Acceptance criteria

- Task details retain objective, lifecycle, current summary, next step, blockers, criteria, linked documents and recorded evidence; unmanaged/historical content is labeled.
- Approval, implementation, recorded assignment, observed activity and release evidence remain distinct. Cross-record links use explicit references, never title similarity.
- Unknown, incompatible, malformed or partially read owners yield bounded module limitations; generated indexes do not override canonical records and no mutation/repair is dispatched.
- Project only permitted human-readable Work fields; remove unsupported collaboration fields, private native material and their counts before returning data. The read-only continue helper never becomes a browser resume action.

### Planned verification

- Inspect fixed read-only owner entry points and response mapping, including the currently observed distinction between completed Task work and separately stale plan lifecycle; reuse unaffected owner validation evidence.

## TASK-005 - Reuse knowledge and permitted memory readers

Expose existing Explorer knowledge behavior as the Project knowledge adapter and add a search-first Lessons and decisions view through supported memory lexical search and exact reads. Preserve typed knowledge semantics and owner permissions without a second graph or memory store; an empty search view explains how to find saved findings and does not invent a catalog API.

| Dependencies | TASK-003 |

### Risks

- Semantic similarity must not be represented as truth or authority.
- An optional knowledge mismatch must not poison core project identity or unrelated content.

### Acceptance criteria

- Terms, documented processes, relationships and permitted sources use existing knowledge semantics, including asserted/inferred/derived/external/historical distinctions and continuation limits.
- Memory findings retain applicability, supporting evidence and recorded history/supersession, remain separate from definitions, and use the memory owner corpus.
- Missing memory or ontology access leaves other views available; no backend activation, acknowledgement, publication or data refresh mutation is invoked.

### Planned verification

- Compare adapter calls and returned fields with installed ontology and memory read contracts; inspect failure boundaries and preservation of existing knowledge routes.

## TASK-006 - Unify permitted source viewing and lexical search

Add typed lexical aggregation over bounded core document references, Work records and available knowledge/memory owners, with owner-scoped source opening/copying and explicit coverage/freshness information.

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Status | `planned` |
| State reason | None |
| Skip authority | None |
| Requirements | REQ-005, REQ-015, REQ-016, REQ-019, REQ-020, REQ-021, REQ-022, REQ-023 |
| Design basis | None |
| Target artifacts | SKILLS-depo/ontology/scripts/project_app_sources.py, SKILLS-depo/ontology/scripts/project_app_search.py, SKILLS-depo/ontology/references/project-app-contract.md |
| Dependencies | TASK-004, TASK-005 |
| Parallel group | None |
| Completed at | None |

### Risks

- Core document selection cannot become a general filesystem browser.
- Avoid a new persistent cache/index subsystem; derive bounded responses through current owners.

### Acceptance criteria

- Known IDs, titles and supported permitted text are searchable without semantic services; results identify owner, type, source and observation/version information.
- No matches, unavailable owner, unsupported content and partial scanning remain distinct; search does not widen the memory corpus or include unapproved child/collaboration material.
- Source handles, counts, previews, copied logical references and cached responses enforce the same root/owner permission rules and current revocation checks; unknown historical versions say Not recorded.

### Planned verification

- Inspect the source-handle and search aggregation paths for bounded owner dispatch, safe rendering inputs and late/revoked response invalidation; identify only novel access gaps for TASK-017.

## TASK-007 - Read capability health and installed help

Add small read adapters for existing health/setup/Curator notices, supported skills and valid role pairs. Return human-readable effects and recovery/copy instructions without triggering a runtime assessment, repair or agent launch automatically.

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Status | `planned` |
| State reason | None |
| Skip authority | None |
| Requirements | REQ-006, REQ-007, REQ-017, REQ-018, REQ-019, REQ-020, REQ-021, REQ-023 |
| Design basis | None |
| Target artifacts | SKILLS-depo/ontology/scripts/project_app_capabilities.py, SKILLS-depo/ontology/assets/project-app/owner-compatibility.json |
| Dependencies | TASK-003 |
| Parallel group | None |
| Completed at | None |

### Risks

- Capability discovery must not execute arbitrary copied modules or infer running agents from installed role names.
- Do not rerun expensive optional health probes on every page load.

### Acceptance criteria

- Installed, configured, disabled, incompatible, unavailable and not checked remain distinct; static results are not relabeled runtime observations.
- Health reuses existing owners/notices and creates no queue or repair loop; deliberately disabled optional modules remain ordinary states.
- Skill and role help explains purpose, inputs, outputs and limits using supported installed metadata; a copy-instruction control says that it only copies.

### Planned verification

- Inspect owner diagnostics and metadata reads; compare selected help instructions to installed CLI syntax without starting services or invoking maintenance.
